get.description: The process is up. Does not touch dependencies.
The API can serve traffic: its dependencies are reachable.

Signs the user in and sets the session cookie.
Revokes the current session. Succeeds even if the session is already invalid.

delete.description: Deletes the collection. Its documents are kept and become unassigned.

post.description: Stores a file and queues it for processing. Poll the document for its status.

delete.description: Deletes the document, its extracted content and its stored file.

post.description: Queues the document for processing again, e.g. after a failure.

get.description: Downloads the original uploaded file. Always served as an attachment.

put.description: Replaces the note's title and body. A changed body is processed again.

get.description: The text chunks extracted from the document, in reading order.

post.description:
Returns the chunks of the user's ready documents most relevant to the query.

By default, semantic (vector) and keyword (full-text) results are fused with Reciprocal
Rank Fusion. Each result carries what a citation needs: document, chunk position, page
range (PDF) or heading trail.

file.title: File
file.description: PDF, DOCX, Markdown or plain text

DocumentUpdate.title: DocumentUpdate
DocumentUpdate.description: Only the fields that are sent are changed. Send `collection_id: null` to unassign.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: Error body returned by every failing endpoint.

mode.description: hybrid: vector + full text fused with RRF (default); vector or fulltext: a single method, for debugging and evaluation

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description: The searching user always comes from the session, never from the request body.

score.title: Score
score.description: Ordering score of the mode: RRF score (hybrid), cosine similarity (vector) or, for full text, the number of distinct query words matched plus ts_rank_cd (below 1). Only comparable within one response.

similarity.title: Similarity
similarity.description: Cosine similarity to the query; null in fulltext mode or when the chunk has no current embedding.
